component.name: RustCooling
component.summary: Ultra-lightweight LCD display controller for ID-COOLING FX series liquid coolers

description.p: RustCooling is a zero-bloat, ultra-lightweight LCD display controller designed for ID-COOLING FX series liquid coolers (FX240, FX280, FX360) and compatible WCH-based AIO hardware.

ul.li: Hardware-accelerated Slint GUI with smooth animations and minimal memory footprint
Direct native telemetry reading from Linux kernel hwmon and sysfs without background bloat
Configurable exponential moving average and deadband hysteresis temperature smoothing
System tray integration with quick controls
Full runtime localization in English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, German, and French

screenshot.caption: Main monitor screen with CPU telemetry

description.p: Release 1.0.4 with improved telemetry polling and UI responsiveness.
